name: LMArena
intro: LMArena 源自 Chatbot Arena，是匿名双模型对战的人类偏好评测平台。论文快照包含 243,329 场对战、50 个模型和 90,051 名用户；在数据质量控制与专家复标后，使用重加权 Bradley–Terry 模型估计排行榜及置信区间。
build_method: 匿名在线众包成对比较
metric: Bradley–Terry score, win rate, confidence interval
task_type: 开放式多轮对话, 人类偏好评测
eval_feature: 匿名盲测, 主动配对采样, 专家复标
scale: 论文快照 243,329 场对战 / 50 个模型 / 90,051 名用户
task_type_en: Open-ended multi-turn dialogue, human preference evaluation
eval_feature_en: Anonymous blind voting, active pair sampling, expert relabeling
intro_en: LMArena originates from Chatbot Arena, an anonymous two-model battle platform for human-preference evaluation. The paper snapshot contains 243,329 battles, 50 models, and 90,051 users; after data-quality controls and blind expert relabeling, a reweighted Bradley–Terry model estimates leaderboard scores and confidence intervals.
metric_en: Bradley–Terry score, win rate, confidence interval
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2403.04132, especially Sections 2–4 and the January 21, 2024 paper snapshot, plus official FastChat repository snapshot 587d5cf. The diagram preserves anonymous random-side model sampling, free-form multi-turn user prompts, four vote labels, post-vote identity reveal, identity-keyword and unsafe-content filtering, anomalous-user detection, 243,329 battles from 90,051 users over 50 models and 149 languages, blind expert relabeling of 160 battles with 72–83% crowd–expert agreement, non-uniform pair-sampling correction, reweighted Bradley–Terry maximum likelihood, robust sandwich confidence intervals, and uncertainty-aware approximate ranks. It deliberately does not label the paper's current method as Elo.
